themes_detail.label: Pigeon Infestation Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Unsanitary pigeon complaints spiked 1100% THIS WEEK (3 complaints vs. 0.2 weekly average over 8 weeks), signaling a potential public health and sanitation crisis in Riverdale that warrants immediate investigation into root causes and city response.
evidence: 3 unsanitary pigeon complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.2 average per week over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 6.35)
1100% spike — highest statistical anomaly in district data
No recent news coverage or community board discussion, suggesting under-reported emerging issue
reporting_angles: Door-knock reporting in affected neighborhoods (likely parks or commercial areas with food waste); interview residents about visibility and health concerns
Investigate whether NYC Parks or Sanitation has resource constraints or policy gaps in pigeon management in Riverdale

themes_detail.label: Street Infrastructure Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Street sign failures spiked 1100% LAST WEEK (3 dangling sign complaints vs. 0.2 weekly average) while overgrown tree/branch complaints jumped 500% LAST WEEK (3 vs. 0.5 average), suggesting neglected public infrastructure maintenance across the district.
evidence: Street sign dangling complaints: 3 LAST WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average (z-score: 4.16, 1100% spike)
Overgrown tree/branches: 3 LAST WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly average (z-score: 5.0, 500% spike)
Aligns with recurring CB budget request for 'new equipment for maintenance' and 'reconstruct or upgrade park amenities' (unsolved multi-year issue)
reporting_angles: Audit specific block locations of dangling signs and overgrown branches; determine if Parks/DOT maintenance crews are understaffed or under-funded
Safety angle: Are dangling signs creating hazards for pedestrians or vehicles? Interview residents about maintenance responsiveness

themes_detail.label: Wildlife Activity Surge
themes_detail.summary: Animal in a park complaints jumped 700% THIS WEEK (3 complaints vs. 0.4 weekly average over 8 weeks), potentially linked to the concurrent pigeon infestation spike and suggesting ecosystem/food-waste management problems in Riverdale parks.
evidence: 3 animal-in-park complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (z-score: 5.42, 700% spike)
Temporal convergence with pigeon spike suggests shared root cause (garbage management, landscaping neglect)
No council constituent cases or recent news coverage indicates emerging rather than long-standing issue
reporting_angles: Which parks are generating animal complaints? Investigate food waste, garbage collection, and feeding practices by visitors
Interview NYC Parks leadership on whether wildlife management is being deprioritized in district maintenance cycles

themes_detail.label: Lead Contamination Alerts
themes_detail.summary: Lead-related complaints surged 264% TWO WEEKS AGO (5 complaints vs. 1.4 weekly average over 8 weeks), a health hazard spike that may reflect either aging housing stock testing or contamination discovery requiring urgent follow-up on affected properties.
evidence: 5 lead complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 1.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.21, 264% spike)
CB has recurring budget request for foster care housing assistance, suggesting vulnerable youth populations in district
High z-score indicates statistically significant anomaly but small absolute volume limits confidence in trend direction
reporting_angles: Identify which properties triggered lead complaints; investigate whether these are rental units, schools, or NYCHA buildings with known exposure risks
Interview tenants about access to lead testing and remediation resources; check whether landlords are complying with disclosure/abatement laws

themes_detail.label: Food Safety Enforcement Spike
themes_detail.summary: Food establishment complaints jumped 357% LAST WEEK (4 complaints vs. 0.9 weekly average over 8 weeks), suggesting either increased vendor enforcement activity or emerging food safety violations in the district's commercial areas.
evidence: 4 food establishment complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.9 weekly average (z-score: 4.0, 357% spike)
Vendor enforcement complaints also spiked 700% TWO WEEKS AGO (3 complaints vs. 0.4 avg), suggesting coordinated enforcement or underlying vendor/food safety issue
Absolute volumes remain small, limiting confidence but pattern warrants monitoring
reporting_angles: Interview DOHMH or vendor enforcement officials on whether this reflects new enforcement campaigns or genuine uptick in violations
Map food establishment complaints against specific vendors/restaurants; consumer angle on which establishments were flagged
